name: sap-adt-hub
description: Connect Claude to several SAP ABAP systems at once through ADT, powered by ARC-1. Add systems in the chat or in the settings.
long_description:
SAP ADT Hub runs one ARC-1 (SAP ADT MCP server) per SAP connection, so any Claude chat can read and develop ABAP (classic and RAP) on several systems side by side: source code, DDIC, CDS, transports, ATC, unit tests, dumps and more.

- Add connections by asking Claude (the password is typed in a Windows dialog, never in the chat) or in these settings.
- Every time a connection starts, the hub checks npm for a newer ARC-1, installs it and tells Claude what is new.
- Connections are read-only until you allow writes, SQL or data preview for that connection.
- Compatible with the ARC-1 multi-system helper folder (~/.arc1).

Requires Node.js LTS with npm (https://nodejs.org).

config_dir.title: Connections folder
config_dir.description: Where connections (systems/*.env) and encrypted passwords (secrets/*.sec) are stored. Same layout as the ARC-1 multi-system helper.

default_system.title: Default system (optional)
default_system.description: Connection id used when Claude does not name one, e.g. D58.

auto_update.title: Update ARC-1 automatically
auto_update.description: When a connection starts, check npm for a newer ARC-1 and install it.

conn_id.title: Settings connection: id (optional)
conn_id.description: Optional connection defined here instead of in the chat, e.g. DEV.

conn_password.title: Settings connection: password
conn_password.description: Stored in the system keychain by Claude Desktop.

conn_insecure.title: Settings connection: accept self-signed certificates
conn_insecure.description: Only for lab systems with untrusted TLS certificates.
